_source: Part 1 §3.2, Part 3 §5, Part 9 A10 (plans/evil-mode-rework); D10 hand data, made by tools/dominion/growth-data.py

loan-shark.win: You lend ₽300 at a "friendly" rate. ₽{back} is due back on Day {due}.

buy-out.win: {target} is yours: the keys, the books and the staff.

museum-heist.win: Glass, a soft click, and the case is empty by morning: {loot}. The Fence will want to see this.
museum-heist.lose: A guard on a late round. You leave the case where it was.

fence.win: The Fence looks it over and pays.

three-on-one.win: Three of them, one of you. Prize money times three: ₽{pay}.

gauntlet.win: Five fights, no rest: you walk the gauntlet.

rooftop-chase.win: Over the roofs and down a fire escape. They lose you in the washing lines. Heat −10.
rooftop-chase.lose: A dead end, a whistle, and a long talk at the station.

hire-a-specialist.win: {name} shakes your hand and puts the tool kit down.

forge-papers.win: A permit, a stamp, a signature nobody can tell apart. One forged paper ready.
forge-papers.lose: The ink runs. You burn it.

hack-the-terminal.win: A file copied, a warrant gone. Every place in {district} is scouted, and Wanted falls 5.
hack-the-terminal.lose: The screen locks. Somewhere an alarm rings.

dig-the-dirt.win: A name, a date, a photo nobody was meant to see. You have dirt on {owner}.
dig-the-dirt.lose: Nothing. They are cleaner than they look.

kidnap-a-pokemon.win: A back door, a Ball in your coat. {mon} is in the Pens, cooling off.
kidnap-a-pokemon.lose: The Pokémon cries out. Lights come on upstairs.

hit-a-lab.win: Parts, data and a fridge of samples: {loot}.
hit-a-lab.lose: The lab aide is still at the desk. You walk on by.

pokemon-swap-meet.win: The Fence opens a crate of Balls. One of them is yours now: {mon}, in the Reserve.

fossil-dig.win: You dig until your hands hurt: {loot}.

smuggle.win: The van rolls into {district} with its lights off. ₽{pay}.
smuggle.lose: A checkpoint on the bridge. You turn the van round.

open-a-black-market-stall.win: A back room, a curtain, and three shelves of things nobody should sell.

run-the-docks.win: The ships pay to unload: ₽{pay}, and the harbour pays every week now.
run-the-docks.lose: The harbour master has friends in uniform.

underground-auction.win: Paddles go up in a dark room. The best bid: ₽{pay}.
underground-auction.lose: The bidders smell police. The room empties.

contraband-run.win: Banned goods, past the checkpoint in a crate of cabbages: ₽{pay}.

tunnel.win: A tunnel under the street, a way out nobody knows. You lie low tonight. Heat −5.
tunnel.lose: The roof of the tunnel comes down. Start again.

air-drop.win: A Flying Pokémon drops the parcel on a roof in {district}: ₽{pay}.
air-drop.lose: Wind. The parcel lands in the river.

safehouse-network.win: A flat above a shop in {district}, rent paid in cash. Heat cools faster there.

rare-candy-ring.win: The candy money comes in, with a little extra in the box: {loot}. (The game has no Rare Candy item, so the ring pays in cash.)

fake-shipment.win: The police chase an empty crate across town. Heat −5, Wanted −5.

post-flyers.win: Flyers on every lamp post in {district}.

spread-the-word.win: You talk up the team on every corner of {district}. Regard +3.

sabotage-the-station.win: Cut wires, a jammed radio, a flat tyre on every car. Wanted −10, and no patrol tonight.

dodge-looker.win: You move the books, burn the notes and change the locks. Looker goes home empty-handed this week.
dodge-looker.lose: Looker writes something down and smiles.

evidence-locker-visit.win: Three boxes of evidence, gone. Wanted −15.
evidence-locker-visit.lose: The locker room has a new lock.

sabotage.win: Sand in the gears of the rival team's work in {district}.
sabotage.lose: The rival team's guards are awake.

hire-mercenaries.win: Hard faces for hire. They are yours for {days} days: every fight job is easier.

intimidate-a-leader.win: You wait outside their house. {leader} gets the message: shaken for a week.

court-a-leader.win: A gift, a dinner, a favour. {leader} likes you a little.

rig-the-badge.win: The badge case is marked: the {badge} Badge is yours without a fight.
rig-the-badge.lose: An inspector is in the Gym today.

midnight-market.win: Lanterns under the bridge. You trade until dawn: ₽{pay}.
midnight-market.lose: Nobody wants what you have tonight.

blackout.win: The lights go out across {district}. Your tracks go with them. Heat −6.

the-big-night.win: The Big Night: three more night jobs before dawn.

business.name: Pewter Poké Mart
business.text: Your Balls on the shelf: 3 Poké Balls a week.

business.name: Viridian Poké Mart
business.text: 2 Potions a week from the stockroom.

business.name: Cerulean Bike Shop
business.text: Fast bikes for the crew: +5% on jobs in Cerulean.

business.name: Celadon Department Store
business.text: Six floors and a rooftop. Regard +1 in Celadon each week.

business.name: Celadon Game Corner
business.text: Rocket's front. Big laundering: ₽200 of dirty money comes out clean each week.

business.name: Lavender Poké Mart
business.text: A quiet shop in a quiet town: Heat −2 in Lavender each week.

business.name: Vermilion Harbour
business.text: Ships that ask no questions: +5% on jobs in Vermilion.

business.name: Silph Co. floors
business.text: Tech parts and research: 2 Ultra Balls a week. Master Ball research comes with the regions (D15).

business.name: Saffron Daily (station newsstand)
business.text: You control the Morning Report's spin: the Hero's Threat −1 a week.

business.name: Safari Zone gate
business.text: Holiday money at the gate: +₽100 a week.

business.name: Saffron Fighting Dojo
business.text: A battle venue: hard trainers, +5% on jobs in Saffron.

gyms.why: Rocket's own Boss runs this Gym: it falls when Rocket falls (D14). You can only beat him.

ways.name: Beat
ways.text: Beat the Leader. A badge and Dread, but the Gym stays theirs.

ways.name: Buy
ways.text: Buy the building and the sponsors with clean money. The Leader stays as your puppet.

ways.name: Break
ways.text: Raid the Gym: every trainer, then the Leader, no rest. The Leader flees and the Gym is yours.

ways.name: Blackmail
ways.text: Scout them three times to find the secret, then confront them. The Leader works for you, quietly.

ways.name: Convert
ways.text: Once beaten, win them over. The Leader joins as an Admin and the Gym trains your crew.

designs.name: The Fist
designs.motto: "Join, or get out of the way."

bribe.name: A police officer
bribe.text: Wanted −10; no patrol in this district for a week.

bribe.name: A town clerk
bribe.text: Heat −10 in this district; the paperwork goes missing.

bribe.name: A Leader's assistant
bribe.text: The Gym here counts as scouted once more (Blackmail needs three).

specialists.name: a Fence
specialists.text: A Black Market contact: Fence, Swap Meet, the Midnight Market and the Candy Ring open.

specialists.name: a Forger
specialists.text: Forge Papers +15%, and a forged paper every week.

specialists.name: a Medic
specialists.text: Hurt members heal a day sooner each night.

lines.noBiz: There is no business here to buy.
lines.rivalBiz: {name} is the rival team's while they hold {district}.
lines.cornered: {owner} is Cornered: they will sell at half price.
lines.cornerStep: Squeezed {n} of {need} times: at {need}, they sell at half.
lines.bizBought: {name} is yours (₽{price}). It pays ₽{income} a week{clean}.
lines.bizForced: {name} is yours, forced at half price (₽{price}). Heat +{heat}, Regard −{regard}.
lines.needClean: You need ₽{n} of clean money (you have ₽{have}).
lines.gymScouts: Scout {district} {n} more time(s) to find {leader}'s secret.
lines.gymMinor: This Leader is a minor: you can only beat them.
lines.beat: You beat {leader}. The {badge} Badge is yours. The Gym stays theirs.
lines.fled: {leader} runs out the back door. They may go to the Hero.
lines.converted: {leader} shakes your hand. They will join when the HQ has room (Admin).
lines.burrowed: {name} slips the route to {district} past a raid (once a week).
lines.chainLost: Beaten at fight {n} of {of}. You pull back.
lines.told: {leader} has told the Hero everything. Heat +{heat}, Hero Threat +{hero}.
lines.breaks: {leader} breaks with you in public and waits for you at the Gym.
lines.defiantWon: {leader} is put back in line. Defiance {n}.
lines.defiantLost: {leader} keeps the Gym. It is theirs again.
lines.appointed: {name} now leads the {district} Gym. The Hero must beat them for the badge.
lines.unappointed: The {district} Gym has no Leader of yours.
lines.flyersTorn: The police tear down your flyers (Wanted {n}).
lines.walkIn: {name}, {cls}, walked in with one of your flyers.
lines.flyersBroke: No money for the flyers: they come down.
lines.noHot: You have no stolen goods to sell.
lines.route: A smuggling route to {district} now pays ₽{n} a night.
lines.seized: Police seize a shipment on the {district} route. The route is gone.
lines.kidnapped: {mon} is in the Pens, cooling off.
lines.labRare: Lab data points to a rare one: {mon} joins the Pens.
lines.loanOut: A loan of ₽{out} is out: ₽{back} back on Day {due}.
lines.loanGone: A borrower skips town with your ₽{n}.
lines.forged: A forged paper is ready ({n} held).
lines.paperUsed: A forged paper gets you through the checkpoint in {district}.
lines.dirtGym: The dirt counts as a scout on {leader}.
lines.safehouse: A safehouse in {district}: Heat there cools {n} more each night.
lines.safehouseHave: You already have a safehouse in {district}.
lines.shaken: {leader} is shaken until Day {day}: −{n} levels when you fight them.
lines.bigNightDone: The Big Night was this week already.
lines.noLeader: Nobody to put at the Gym yet (a Captain or higher).
lines.chef: The chef cooks: Morale +2 for the crew.
lines.swapNone: The Fence has nothing for you today.
lines.contact: Needs a Black Market contact (hire a Fence, or a Black Market Counter).
lines.gymScouted: Scout the Gym first (the district it stands in).
lines.gymAlly: Needs a Gym ally: one you own or a Leader you courted.
lines.fly: Needs a Pokémon that knows Fly.
lines.surf: Needs a Pokémon that knows Surf.
lines.jailed: Needs a member in a cell.
lines.fell: Needs a member who got hurt.
lines.gymYoursCard: The Gym is yours: pick a Leader, or give them a raise.
lines.revived: {name} revives a fossil: {mon} joins the Pens.
lines.union: The docks keep quiet now: routes pay {cut}% less, Smuggle runs at half the Heat.
lines.strike: The dockworkers strike: no smuggling for {days} days.
lines.struck: The docks are on strike until day {day}.
lines.courtFence: The Fence takes the hot goods at {pct}% when you are next at your Bag.
lines.courtFenceWeek: The Fence will take your hot goods at {pct}% every week.
lines.courtFenceNone: You had no hot goods for the Fence.
lines.judge: The judge leans on the police: pick-ups {pct}% less likely for {days} days.
lines.judgeDirt: He made an enemy of you: there is dirt on the judge now (Blackmail him).
lines.informant: You know the sweep's date: no pick-up for {days} days.
lines.council: A council seat: the police budget is {pct}% lower for good.
lines.heist: The joint heist is on: the crate comes in when you are next at your Bag.
lines.koga: Koga trains the crew: Steal and Thieve +{n}% for {days} days.
lines.gymLost: The Leader goes public. {gym} is not yours any more.
lines.giftFull: No room for {name}: it is sold for ₽{n}, clean.
lines.accountant: The accountant launders at {fee}% (no front needed).
lines.accountantTalk: The accountant talked to the police: Heat +{n}.
lines.machine: The lab machine goes into {room}: one tier up.
lines.machineNone: No room can use the lab machine yet; it waits in a cupboard.
lines.architect: The next HQ level costs {pct}% less.
lines.weakSpot: The cheaper design left a weak spot: Defense -{n}.

riddles: What type is weak to Water, Ground and Rock?
Which Pokémon evolves from Vulpix with a Fire Stone?
Which burn cure is sold in every Poké Mart?
Which Fire-type move has 90 power and may burn the target?
Which Kanto Gym stands on a volcano island?
